customer_contract.product: Founder-reviewed NYC restaurant research briefs built from official records
customer_contract.delivery: Weekly; first brief within five business days; a no-matches note is sent when nothing credible qualifies
customer_contract.starter_snapshot: Optional, clearly labeled, up to 10 still-active records first detected during the prior seven days
customer_contract.refund: First subscription payment refundable before first send and through seven calendar days after the provider-confirmed first brief or no-matches note
customer_contract.limitations: Research starting points only; no scores, purchase-intent, opening-probability, exclusivity, or outcome guarantee

free_trial.admission: Supervised scope review after customer sends an email request

release_stage: Founder-curated first-customer launch with supervised trial request
commercial_proof: Not claimed until a real paid subscriber, provider-backed delivery, and next-run duplicate suppression are verified
